---
name: Product feedback
about: Suggest an improvement or describe a difficult Codev workflow
title: "[Feedback] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Workflow or capability

Which Codev panel, Elysia bridge workflow, approval step, or Developer-profile
capability is this about?

## Current experience

Explain what is confusing, missing, or unnecessarily difficult. Do not include
source code that you cannot publish, credentials, private data, or confidential
repository details.

## Desired outcome

Describe the result you want without assuming that workspace trust, repository
approval, exact authorization, local-first behavior, or other safety boundaries
should be removed.

## Preservation context

If the suggestion changes an established workflow, explain what current
capability or compatibility must remain.

## Safety check

- [ ] This is not a vulnerability report. Use the private security contact in
      the issue chooser for security concerns.
- [ ] I removed private or sensitive information.
